title: Contacts attached to the wrong accounts after the pilot import
scenario: Keystone's first pilot import of a Salesforce-shaped export exited 0, but sales ops reports contacts under the wrong customer, about a dozen accounts missing and some tasks never arriving. The reconciliation report shows an Account difference nobody can explain, and the partner-portal wave (which still sends 15-character ids) is blocked until you find out why.
task: Find the root cause from the export, the pilot database, the import log and the code
Fix the importer so every legacy record keeps its identity and both extracts link correctly
Make the reconciliation report clean while still listing legitimate rejects
Write the root cause with evidence and production follow-ups in ANSWER.md
acceptance: canonical_id handles 15- and 18-character ids correctly and rejects malformed ids
Every named account imported exactly once; every contact on the exact account it names
Recon has zero unexplained mismatches, lists rejects, and a re-run is idempotent
ANSWER.md root cause backed by concrete ids and numbers from the bundle
